description: Machine-readable data classification (ADR-002 as revised by ADR-008). Two classes; every path has exactly one. 'public' is the complement: any tracked file not matching never_in_git is public by definition, and the coverage test enforces that nothing personal is tracked.

never_in_git.description: Exists only on this machine: the database (all personal data per ADR-008), credentials, artifacts, state, logs. Must be gitignored and absent from the index.
